Another tactic involves misclassifying income.  For example, an individual might receive a payment that represents earned income but attempts to categorize it as a gift or loan.  The IRS carefully scrutinizes transactions that appear to be disguised income. For instance, a self-employed individual might claim meals as business expenses when they were, in reality, personal meals.

Finally, some individuals attempt to hide income by using offshore accounts or nominee entities. These arrangements involve transferring funds to foreign accounts or using shell companies to conceal ownership.
